note: Knox County, IN (18083): the Area Plan Commission administers county zoning and the Vincennes code covers city limits. The zoning ordinance says the Official Zoning Maps are adopted by reference and kept for inspection at the Area Plan Office. No ArcGIS REST, WFS or downloadable zoning-district layer was found for the county or for Vincennes. The county's public map viewer (knoxin.wthgis.com) exposes no service endpoints, the Beacon viewer is access-blocked, and KGIS services belong to Knox County, Tennessee. Only commercial parcel products (Regrid, Rockford, Mapping Solutions) carry zoning, and those are paid, so they are not used.
